entities.summary: Chia-Jen Lo is a Taiwanese former professional baseball pitcher who currently serves as a coach for the Wei Chuan Dragons' farm team in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL). He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Houston Astros and in the CPBL for the Fubon Guardians.
